title_line: Construction Site Manager  |  Field Operations, Quality & Safety  |  PMP
summary: Construction and field operations leader who started on job sites as a concrete foreman and industrial fabrication worker and now runs projects from start to finish. As project manager for a Lehi home builder, Eric ran jobs across Utah and Salt Lake counties and put construction SOPs, inventory tracking, equipment maintenance, fleet management, and quality and safety controls in place. Earlier he scheduled crews and coordinated up to ten contractors on remodeling jobs, and as an ION Solar area manager he tracked solar projects through install, inspection, utility requirements, and permission to operate. A PMP and Certified Scrum Product Owner, he keeps schedules, documentation, and progress reporting clean for the people he reports to, and is available for a 12 to 24 month site commitment.

paragraphs: Every job site runs on the same few things. The trades need a clear daily plan, the sequence has to hold, and somebody has to catch the quality and safety problems before an inspector does. That's the field work I've built my career on, and it's why this Eagle Mountain project caught my eye.

Most recently I ran residential construction jobs start to finish for a Lehi home builder. I put construction SOPs in place, added inventory tracking and an equipment maintenance program, managed the vehicle fleet, and set up quality and safety controls on our sites. Before that I scheduled crews and coordinated up to ten contractors on remodeling jobs. I started out in the field as a concrete foreman running ground crews, then spent two years in an industrial fabrication shop rolling boiler pipe. As a PMP, I keep schedules, documentation, and progress reports clean for whoever I answer to.

But I'll be straight about the gap. I haven't built a power generation facility, and most of my site leadership has been residential. What I'd bring is energy industry experience from ION Solar and Lion Energy, plus a habit of making progress visible and fixing field issues fast. The 12 to 24 month commitment works well for me. Could we talk this week about how Epcon runs its sites?
